dogecoin.text: What's up with #dogecoin up 60% today with heavy volume?

@francispouliot_ @SatoshiLite Right now opening/closing LN channels in bitcoin is simple and cheap but there will be a limit reached soon. Litecoin fills this need with atomic swaps. $LTC not as secure POW-wise as $BTC but can handle less valuable tx and more dynamically. Likewise with $DOGE and $VTC

@PeterRizun @ndrchvzz If your LN tx volume is too low for the current miner fees, you can use other chains like Litecoin or even Dogecoin. There can be gateways via atomic swaps to drain your low funded channel away.
@DougPolkVids Shorting any crypto Is a really bad idea even $DOGE
